why: The typed-draw surface decoupled from the GL device (engine): engine/platform/ps2e/ps2e_draw.cpp reached past render::Backend into GlDevice (the stencil target, the run brackets, the state cache, the constant VAO, a shader of its own, raw GL stencil calls). What it needed was lifted onto render::Backend (StencilState.depth_fail_op applied by a register-program draw, MarkStencilWhereOpaque, ReadbackStencil, BeginDrawRun / EndDrawRun, SetWindowSize) and the surface now speaks the abstract interface only, through an arm (ps2e_draw_backend_{gl,null}.cpp) CMake selects. The GL arm's picture must not move: this judge is GREEN before and GREEN after BY DESIGN -- it freezes that the refactor is a refactor.
